missions.name: Prologue
missions.overview: The game opens with Lucia in prison, following a guard to a counseling session. A flashback plays out the robbery that put her there, ending in an arrest at a coffee shop.
tips: The police escape in the flashback is scripted to fail - Lucia's arrest cannot be avoided, so do not restart trying to escape (PowerPyx).
Use the opening to learn the look/talk controls: aim with L2/LT, talk with X/A.
missions.reward_notes: No reward reported by any source checked.

missions.name: Gone Fishing
missions.overview: Jason's first mission: he follows Donnie's plane by boat, collecting the packages it drops over Kingfisher gang territory. When Donnie is captured, Jason sneaks into the Kingfishers' swamp camp, frees him, and flies the seaplane back to Brian's Marina.
tips: Stealth and leg shots build a 'professional' reputation; killing pushes you toward 'psychopath', and at the worst levels police may shoot on sight (PowerPyx).
You can carry up to 5 Zombix healing items; buy more at convenience stores.
missions.reward: Unlock: Jason's house in Key Lento
missions.missable_warning: Optional and easy to miss: Donnie's cash sits in a white-and-red trailer on the way to the seaplane; grabbing it also raises professional reputation.

missions.name: Gear Up
missions.overview: Jason heads to the gun store near his Key Lento house (named Chuck's Tackle and Shot by GAMES.GG) to buy his first longarm. As he leaves, three Kingfisher gang members pull up in a truck and a shootout follows.
tips: You can likely only afford the shotgun at this point - that is enough for the fight.
If you die in the shootout you respawn at home and the mission still ends; PowerPyx says neither outcome has a lasting impact.
missions.reward_notes: No cash reward reported; the longarm is bought by the player, not awarded.

missions.name: Just a Scratch
missions.overview: Jason takes his battered '70 Ganado to Joey at the garage by his house for repairs: the free Full Engine repair, then Cosmetics and a free respray in any color. It is a short vehicle-care tutorial early in the chapter.
tips: Do NOT spend money upgrading the Ganado - PowerPyx warns the car is replaced later in the story and its upgrades are lost.
If you wrecked the car, load your last save and it will be back outside the house.
missions.reward_notes: No cash reward reported; the repair and respray themselves are free.

missions.name: Lab Fees
missions.overview: Jason collects Brian's outstanding rent from a locked boutique in Key Lento; after punching the clerk once, he is offered acid from the back room instead. He opens the lab with keypad code 0420, takes the acid, and stashes it in Brian's lockup (door code 7700).
tips: Lab keypad code is 0420 - the clerk gives it, or check the notepad.
Brian's lockup door code is 7700.
Robbing the boutique register is optional extra cash.
The $600 reward arrives later in the mailbox outside Jason's house because you have no bank account yet - remember to collect it.
missions.reward: $600 (delivered later to the mailbox outside Jason's house)

missions.name: Unwanted Attention
missions.overview: Jason meets Cal on the beach in north Key Lento and drives with him to the Hamlet impound to steal back a red Phoenix hooked to a tow truck. After losing the police, he runs it through a Pay 'n' Spray, delivers it to Brian's garage, and changes his hat and glasses to lower his recognition.
tips: Unhook the Phoenix and get in fast; knocking out guards or waiting at the gate brings the police.
Changing clothes, headwear, glasses or car lowers how recognizable you are - a system that matters for the rest of the game.
missions.reward_notes: The Gamers Hub (from PowerPyx) lists $150 + police scanner app; TopNoted's summary additionally mentions a WAiNK car-scanning app, which is single-source.

missions.name: Pipework
missions.overview: Jason visits tenant Mandy to collect rent and ends up doing plumbing: grab the plunger from the bathroom floor, then fix the kitchen sink with the plunger (R3) and the wrench (R2/RT). Mandy throws out a Macizo cigar as he leaves.
tips: Pick up the Macizo cigar Mandy discards before you leave.
Per PowerPyx, Pipework needs the other early errands done first; guides order the early errands differently because several unlock at the same time.
missions.reward_notes: No reward reported by any source checked.

missions.name: Hey Arnold!
missions.overview: After Brian's call, Jason meets him at the pool bar in south Key Lento, picks up Cal, and tracks down Arnold, Brian's broker, in a pink search area. The meeting goes wrong: Jason chases Arnold's car while his men shoot from motorbikes, then catches him on foot at the docks and chooses whether to kill or spare him.
tips: In vehicles: L1/LB draws your gun, R1/RB fires, and clicking both sticks slows time.
PowerPyx says the kill-or-spare choice at the docks has the same outcome either way.
missions.reward_notes: No reward reported by any source checked.

missions.name: Island Dreams
missions.overview: Jason works for dive-shop owner Kenton Rees in Key Lento: he boats to the dive spot, leads a bachelor party through a trench to a shipwreck, and uses a metal detector to find three golden chests. He then frees the trapped Dobbs and drives off a shark with a harpoon.
tips: Two harpoon hits drive the shark off and Dobbs survives; either way only the ending dialogue changes.
Hold R1/RB near sea life to log species for the 100% checklist.
missions.reward_notes: The Gamers Hub lists $400; TopNoted's summary adds 'plus treasure found' during the dive.

missions.name: Feng Shui
missions.overview: Cal comes over to Jason's house and the two rearrange the furniture - TV, coffee table, couch and chair. Afterwards they play two arcade games, Tenebrae Lux and Street Trash III, neither of which can be won; the next morning the prison calls about Lucia's release.
tips: Do not waste time trying to beat the arcade games: walk to the locked door in the first, and just die or let the timer run out in the second (PowerPyx).
This mission triggers Lucia's release call the next morning, leading into Coming Home - finish any Key Lento errands first.
missions.reward_notes: No reward reported by any source checked.

missions.name: Coming Home
missions.overview: Lucia is released from prison and Jason picks her up, driving her to the Rusty Anchor bar north of Key Lento. They order beers, hang out, dance, play pool with Mattia, and deal with trouble at the bar.
tips: Do all five optional prep errands first - groceries, flowers, the necklace at The Siren's Chest ($425), a haircut at The Chop, and Lucia's clothes from Andy - to start the relationship at 3 out of 4 (PowerPyx).
Buy the necklace: it matters again in Chapter 2, where it is used as collateral in Overnight Charges.
missions.reward_notes: No cash reward reported; the payoff is relationship rating.
missions.missable_warning: The five prep errands must be done BEFORE picking Lucia up if you want the relationship boost; they cannot be done afterwards.

missions.name: Buck Me
missions.overview: Lucia calls Jason to the Fleeca bank in Key Lento to set up banking, since their credit is too low for a normal account. After meeting the manager, Jason gets the BuckMe app with $100 in a checking account, which can be moved into Family Savings.
tips: Move the $100 into Family Savings with 'Buck Yourself' - Family Savings money can never be lost, while pocket cash is lost when you die.
Purchases over $1,000 are paid through BuckMe; deposit pocket cash at any ATM to keep it safe.
missions.reward: Unlock: BuckMe banking app (account starts with $100 in checking)

missions.name: Clean Up After Donnie
missions.overview: Donnie phones the morning after Coming Home about a lost package in the swamps south-west of Hamlet. Jason searches the pink area, asks the fisherman on the docks, fights three Kingfishers at a shack to recover the cocaine, and boats it to Donnie's trailer in Key Lento.
tips: Ask the fisherman on the docks to narrow down the package's location.
The $600 reward arrives later in the mailbox at Jason's house - collect it before Chapter 1 ends.
missions.reward: $600 (delivered later to the mailbox at Jason's house)

missions.name: Down to Earth
missions.overview: A smuggling job for Brian: Jason pressure-washes a boat at the marina, then flies the seaplane with Lucia to the far north-west of Mariana County to fish a drug package out of the water. After a gunfight with smugglers, they make three package drops by water landing and hide the drugs in a washing machine under the house.
tips: Shooting arms and legs builds professional reputation; killing builds violent reputation - either completes the mission.
After this mission, speak to Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and accept the balcony meditation (see missable warning).
missions.reward_notes: No cash reward reliably reported; The Gamers Hub/PowerPyx note it unlocks the first of 18 Meditation Spots (terrace).
missions.missable_warning: After Down to Earth, the morning balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house may be required for the Positive Mental Attitude trophy and is unavailable after Chapter 1 (KeenGamer).

missions.name: Clear Skies
missions.overview: Brian sends Jason to meet Donnie at the seaplane in Southwind in the afternoon. Jason flies cover directly above Pilot Pete's plane to hide its radar signature, escorts it to a swamp airstrip, then fights off the Final Chapter biker gang and escapes by plane.
tips: Go in the afternoon - if you arrive at another time, hold the prompt button to wait.
Fly directly above Pete's plane to mask its radar signature during the escort.
You can scan the bikers' motorcycles with the WAiNK app.
missions.reward_notes: No reward reported by any source checked.

missions.name: Day Release
missions.overview: Mattia calls after Down to Earth and invites the couple out: drinks at the Rusty Anchor, a speedboat ride to a yacht off Vice City, a jet ski race and champagne-bottle target shooting, then a night that runs through the Nine1Nine club and a hotel balcony pool jump. Day Release and Clear Skies unlock at the same time and can be done in either order.
tips: Winning the jet ski race does not matter, and hitting every champagne bottle only changes one line of dialogue later.
Holding hands in some scenes can raise the relationship level.
missions.reward_notes: PowerPyx (via The Gamers Hub) explicitly reports no reward for this mission.

missions.name: Swamped
missions.overview: Brian takes Jason to meet the Kingfishers at their camp in the north-west of Mariana County, where Donnie is revealed to have been killed and fed to the pigs. Jason fights his way out following Brian, chases the target by helicopter and then by boat, and boards the boat for a final fistfight.
tips: Follow Brian during the escape - he has a green dot on the minimap.
During the boat chase, drive very close and hold the prompt to jump across quickly; enemy fire can wreck your engine and force a restart.
At the end, choose to tell Lucia the news about Donnie - PowerPyx recommends it, as it improves the relationship.
missions.reward_notes: DISPUTED - not recorded: IGN, Game8, Beebom and TheGamesWiki report $1,000 deposited via BuckMe, while PowerPyx's walkthrough lists 'Reward: None' and GamesFuze reports no cash or item reward. Sources disagree, so reward is null.
missions.missable_warning: Before starting Swamped: finish all of Donnie's optional missions/activities and sell any narcotics to Donnie - Donnie is gone for good after this mission and his Drop-Off selling location is permanently removed (Showgamer / TheGamesWiki). The optional 'Ring the Bell!' with Cal is only available on the way to the marina meet.

missions.name: Don Gone
missions.overview: Brian sends Jason to Donnie's trailer in Key Lento to make it look empty after Donnie's death. Jason packs Donnie's belongings, deals with three men from the earlier bar fight, then drives the car out of Key Lento and destroys it.
tips: MISSABLE: open the car trunk BEFORE destroying it to take Donnie's unique H&L .38 revolver - this is your only chance.
Pack all six highlighted items: the photo above the bed, the flight schedule on the night stand, the clothes on the shelf, the ID by the door, the phone message, and the map on the fridge.
You can destroy the car by burning it with the gas canister from the trunk or by sinking it in the ocean.
missions.reward: Unique weapon: Donnie's H&L .38 revolver (in the car trunk; missable)
missions.reward_notes: Sportskeeda's walkthrough also reports $200 sent by Brian via BuckMe - single source, treated as unconfirmed.
missions.missable_warning: Open the car trunk and take the H&L .38 BEFORE destroying the car; it is permanently missable, and unique weapons are kept through the Chapter 1 to Chapter 2 transition.

missions.name: Recalibration
missions.overview: Lucia calls Jason home to cheer up Cal: buy a 6-pack of beer, drive to Cal's house, boat out to a fishing spot, catch three fish, and grill them back at Cal's dock. It is a quiet character mission - and the last free-roam moment of Chapter 1.
tips: Fishing: when a fish bites, push the left stick opposite to where it swims and rotate the right stick to reel in.
Flip each fish on the grill until both sides look done.
missions.reward_notes: No reward reported by any source checked.
missions.missable_warning: POINT OF NO RETURN (PowerPyx): Recalibration is the last free-roam moment of Chapter 1. Afterwards you are locked into the closing mission chain until Chapter 2, you lose all pocket cash you carry, and Jason's Key Lento home is lost permanently. Before starting: make a manual save in its own slot, put at least $5,000 into Family Savings (the amount that carries over), and finish Chapter-1-only optionals such as Shirley's 'Get Shirley's Rum' and 'Steal the Scooter'.

missions.name: Tourist Trap
missions.overview: Mattia's job starts in the south of Key Lento: Jason talks to Lucia, who is picking up trash on the beach, then collects a bag from a locker in the Visitor Center. The job turns into a confrontation with corrupt officers, control switches to Lucia partway through, and the pair escape by boat.
tips: Make a manual save and have at least $5,000 in Family Savings before starting - there is no free roam from here until Chapter 2.
Kenton's quests, fishing for Cal and the yellow Kingfisher hideout icons return later in the game, so they are not lost (PowerPyx).
missions.reward_notes: No reward reported by any source checked.
missions.missable_warning: Part of the locked closing sequence Tourist Trap -> Home Sweet Home -> Discharge Time, with no free roam until Chapter 2; wallet cash, the Key Lento safehouse and its stash are lost, while Family Savings (up to $5,000) and unique weapons carry over.

missions.name: Home Sweet Home
missions.overview: Picking up straight after Tourist Trap, Lucia returns to Jason's house to collect his things. She then has to get away from the area without being seen by the police, crouching to stay hidden in the dark and heading for the main road in Key Lento.
tips: Crouch to stay hidden in the dark and move for the main road in Key Lento.
This mission flows directly from Tourist Trap with no free-roam break - you cannot prepare between them.
missions.reward_notes: No reward reported by any source checked.

missions.name: Discharge Time
missions.overview: The final mission of Chapter 1 starts at Vice City Hospital, where Lucia finds a patient in his room on the second floor. She defends herself through a series of gunfights and finishes with a vehicle chase, leading directly into Chapter 2.
tips: The patient's room is on the second floor of the hospital.
This flows straight into Chapter 2's What's in the Bag? with no break.
missions.reward_notes: No reward reported by any source checked.

missions.name: What's in the Bag?
missions.overview: Chapter 2 opens on its own at the Starlet Motel in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County, right after Discharge Time. Lucia examines the bag from Chapter 1 - a small statue with a note underneath, and a hard drive she has no computer for yet - while Jason recovers.
tips: Flip the statue over and read the note under it, and examine the hard drive - both are required objectives.
From here you play as Lucia in the open world while Jason recovers; most of the chapter is Lucia-led.
missions.reward: Paradise Lost trophy/achievement; Lucia becomes playable in the open world

missions.name: Ambulance Chaser
missions.overview: Lucia has to get rid of the ambulance from the hospital escape, hidden in a barn slightly east of the Starlet Motel. People have already found it and drive off, so she chases it on an ATV until it crashes into a tree, then pours a gas can over it and ignites it.
tips: Stay close on the ATV and do not crash - the ambulance stops by itself when it hits a tree.
Alternative: toss the gas can in the back and shoot it, if you have a gun.
The fire alerts the police - leave the area right away.
missions.reward_notes: PowerPyx (via The Gamers Hub) reports no reward for this mission.
missions.missable_warning: Mission order varies by source: GTABase lists Ambulance Chaser second in the chapter, while PowerPyx marks it as soon as you first leave the motel room - it can be done early.

missions.name: Just Moved In
missions.overview: Lucia settles into the motel by shopping at the Alpha gas station convenience store across the street. She picks up the 8 marked items - soda, protein bars, fruit, soup, gauze, bandanas, hair clippers and a makeup bag - and returns to the motel room.
tips: You pay automatically as you pick each item up - no need to talk to the clerk.
Item markers only show if the minimap is turned on in the UI settings.
missions.reward_notes: Reward per PowerPyx via The Gamers Hub.

missions.name: Girls' Trip
missions.overview: Looking for painkillers for Jason, Lucia asks around the Starlet Motel and is sent to Room 10, where Vicki sells her $50 pills that turn out to be ordinary store-bought ones. After confronting her, Lucia drives Vicki to the Delights club, then on to Dunk's trailer, a boatyard, and a car wash run-in with the Kolts gang.
tips: At the car wash, pick Defuse twice in a row to avoid a fight and gain reputation (PowerPyx recommendation).
The title is Girls' Trip in almost all sources; GameRant's 'Girl's Trap' is a typo.
missions.reward_notes: You first pay $50 for the pills; Vicki repays $50 via BuckMe (PowerPyx via The Gamers Hub).

missions.name: Moses
missions.overview: Lucia takes a low-key vehicle to Moses's auto shop in Port Gellhorn. She scans three vehicles for trackers with the WAiNK app, picks up the Slim Jim and uses it on the Montagne XL, then resprays and registers a tracker-free car - her first registered vehicle.
tips: Only cars with no tracker can be registered; if yours has one, Moses sends you off for another.
Take cars from the main road in the middle of Port Gellhorn, not near his garage.
Slim Jim technique: press Triangle/Y at the door, then tilt the right stick until the bar turns from white to pink.
Afterwards, selling tracker-free stolen cars to Moses ($1,000 or more each) is a main way to save toward the $15,000 Vice City goal.
missions.reward: Slim Jim; Scooter Bros app; a free registered car for Lucia; Moses will buy stolen cars without trackers

missions.name: Daily Driver
missions.overview: Shortly after Moses, Moses texts Lucia a photo of the car he wants: an '82 Crawler, a white jeep parked by the old Trader's Union building with guards around it. Lucia steals it and delivers it to Moses's garage in Port Gellhorn.
tips: You can take out the guards, or just run to the car and drive off.
Deliver the Crawler in good condition for the $500 bonus on top of the $1,250.
missions.reward: $1,250, plus a $500 bonus if the car arrives in good condition
missions.reward_notes: The Gamers Hub/PowerPyx also note Moses later gives you the Port Gellhorn Garage for storing vehicles, and the Vice City Real Estate app unlocks on your phone.

missions.name: Slam Dunk
missions.overview: Once Dunk has called twice, Lucia meets him at his trailer to find painkillers for Jason, following Dr. Bill from a convenience store to the docks. The deal with the Kolts gang goes bad, and after a fight at the airstrip south-west of Port Gellhorn, Lucia drives Dunk home.
tips: Drive slowly through the gate to the docks office; when the meeting goes badly, reverse out and lose the Kolts.
At the airstrip, stay in cover, take it slowly, and heal with Zombix if needed - check the buildings for Kolts too.
missions.reward: Painkillers for Jason; Dunk becomes a Fence; $1,700 sent by Dunk via BuckMe the next day; 2 robbery spots marked on the map

missions.name: Breakfast Run
missions.overview: After Jason calls, a cutscene shows time passing until he is well again, and the pair drive to Hank's Waffles. Lucia robs the diner, then a liquor store and a thrift store, each against a 1-minute timer, before escaping a 2-star wanted level.
tips: Aim your gun at the staff and press Square/X to threaten them, then grab the cash - the 1-minute timer is plenty.
Small off-road paths make the 2-star escape easy.
Jason's call can take about half an in-game day after Slam Dunk - work on other pending missions to trigger it.
missions.reward: Trust trophy/achievement; both Jason and Lucia now have a personal vehicle
missions.reward_notes: Walkthroughs list Lucia as the playable character; Jason becomes playable again as this mission flows into Coffee Break.

missions.name: Coffee Break
missions.overview: Starting immediately after Breakfast Run outside the Starlet Motel, Jason and Lucia walk to the motel kitchen, buy a $2 coffee, and make their plan to move to Vice City. From the end of this mission, free switching between Jason and Lucia opens up.
tips: Free switching: hold D-pad Right, then press R1/RB.
Four optional missions appear on the map together after this mission - Thrillbillies, Hit Avery Pawn, Hit Kingpin Bowling and Impounded Vehicle - do them in any order while saving for Vice City.
missions.reward: Unlock: free switching between Jason and Lucia

missions.name: Afternoon Delight
missions.overview: Vicki calls the pair to rob her boss at Delights, the Port Gellhorn club where she works. It is ladies' night, so only Lucia is let in while Jason climbs the back fence; Jason can choose to help the male dancers perform or not, and either way Lucia robs the office safe before they escape pursuing bikers.
tips: Safe code reported by PowerPyx and PlayerManual: 2008 (one other guide says the combination is sent to your phone).
Choosing Help adds scenes and a clothes stop for Jason; Don't Help is quicker - the outcome and pay are the same.
The $10,000 arrives via BuckMe the NEXT day - wait for it before finishing your $15,000 Vice City savings.
missions.reward: $10,000 sent by Vicki via BuckMe the next day
missions.reward_notes: Amount agreed by PowerPyx, PlayerManual and Showgamer.

missions.name: Checking Out
missions.overview: With every other Chapter 2 main mission done and at least $15,000 saved, the pair are attacked at the Starlet Motel. Jason grabs the shotgun from the bed and fights to the cafeteria, control switches to Lucia, and they escape - Lucia on a bike, Jason in a car - shooting out police tires as they flee toward Vice City.
tips: You need all other Chapter 2 main missions complete AND at least $15,000 before this unlocks.
Bug warning (PowerPyx): if you die on the bike ride, Jason can vanish as an objective - restart the mission to fix it.
During the escape, drive close and hold Square/X to jump from the bike to the car when prompted.
missions.reward_notes: No reward reported by any source checked.
missions.missable_warning: POINT OF NO RETURN: starting Checking Out ends Chapter 2 and the Starlet Motel is permanently lost as your home. Complete Billy's optional missions Thrillbillies and Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (counted as main missions in some 93-mission lists) and any other Port Gellhorn business first, and make a manual save.

missions.name: Welcome to Vice City
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia arrive in Vice City and meet Dre'Quan, the contact who arranged their place to stay. The meeting opens Chapter 3 and sets up their new base and their first work in the city.
tips: Make a manual save at the start of the chapter - GTA VI has no mission replay.
New story assignments often appear after a contact calls; if no marker shows, sleep or do another activity and check the map's pink storybook icon again (KeenGamer).
missions.reward_notes: Not reliably reported - no source checked states a reward for this mission.

missions.name: Dealer's Choice
missions.overview: Jason completes a drug deal arranged through Dre'Quan. It is his first piece of work for Dre'Quan in Vice City and begins their working relationship.
tips: This is a Jason-only mission - start it while controlling Jason.
It unlocks directly from the Dre'Quan contact chain after Welcome to Vice City.

missions.name: Meet the Heders
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia join Brian and his wife Lorrie (spelled Lori in some guides) for a double date. It is a social, story-focused mission reconnecting the couple with Brian in Vice City.
tips: A low-combat, story-focused mission - a good moment to make a manual save before the chapter's heavier jobs begin.
Wife's name is spelled Lorrie in most guides and Lori in some; the mission content is the same.

missions.name: Dubious Provenance
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia visit an antique store and complete the job associated with it. The visit is part of their early Vice City work after meeting Dre'Quan.
tips: Only a one-line objective is consistently reported for this mission; follow the in-game markers at the antique store.
Overview is based on brief guide summaries (KeenGamer / vi.ki / GTAside) rather than a full walkthrough.

missions.name: Mami Knows Best
missions.overview: Lucia meets a member of her family, Mia, progressing her family storyline in Vice City. The meeting leads directly into the M7-related work of the following mission.
tips: This is a Lucia-led mission - start it while controlling Lucia.
It pairs with South Leonida Real Estate, which continues the Mia/M7 storyline.

missions.name: South Leonida Real Estate
missions.overview: Continuing Lucia's work involving Mia, she has a run-in with the M7 gang. The mission extends the family storyline begun in Mami Knows Best.
tips: Expect the M7 confrontation - go in healed and armed.
Lucia-led mission; it follows Mami Knows Best in every list checked.

missions.name: Tyrone
missions.overview: Jason meets Tyrone to ask him for work. Tyrone's assignment sends Jason looking for Charles in the next mission.
tips: Jason-led mission - start it while controlling Jason.
Here, Kitty Kitty follows directly from Tyrone's assignment.

missions.name: Here, Kitty Kitty
missions.overview: Following Tyrone's assignment, Jason searches for Charles. The search closes out the Tyrone thread before Lucia's car work for Raul begins.
tips: Follow the search-area markers to track Charles down.
Note: alternate mission lists place the OPTIONAL mission Kitty Litter Labs right after this one - it is not part of the 26 mandatory missions in the adopted list.

missions.name: Car Service
missions.overview: Lucia steals a requested vehicle for Raul - her first job for him. The theft introduces Raul before the couple formally meet him in First Impressions.
tips: Deliver the requested car to complete Raul's first test.
Name note: GTABase/PowerPyx use the singular 'Car Service'; PC Gamer's list uses 'Car Services'.

missions.name: Top Billing
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia join Dre'Quan at a Real Dimez concert performance. The outing builds Dre'Quan's music-business storyline in Vice City.
tips: A story/social mission rather than a combat job - use the breather to restock before the Raul missions.
It sits between the two Raul introductions (Car Service and First Impressions) in every list checked.

missions.name: Boobie Time
missions.overview: Jason drives Boobie to his destinations and completes his assignment. It introduces Boobie as a Vice City contact who gives the pair bigger work later in the chapter (Bricked Up).
tips: This is a driving mission - a reliable, undamaged car makes the destination runs simpler.
Jason-led mission; Boobie's follow-up job is Bricked Up, later in the chapter.

missions.name: First Impressions
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia meet Raul in person and begin working with his crew. This is the formal start of the Raul storyline that leads toward the Cartel Heist.
tips: Raul's crew and base recur for the rest of the chapter - Credit Check and the heist preparations build on this meeting.
Make a manual save here if you want a clean point before the heist-prep chain.

missions.name: Caught Slipping
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia stop a burglary in progress, defending themselves against the intruders. It is a combat interruption between the Raul introductions and the crew's heist preparations.
tips: Expect a home-defense style fight - keep a loaded longarm from Gear Up-era shopping equipped.

Composition dispute: this mission is mandatory #13 in the adopted list (Dexerto, Radio Times, GameRant-mandatory, GTAside); Space4Games, Push Square and Insider Gaming instead count Kitty Litter Labs in the 26 and omit Caught Slipping. See missions-notes.md.

missions.name: Crosstown Traffic
missions.overview: Lucia tails a gang member for Raul across town while Jason meets Karim. The surveillance feeds into Raul's planning against rival operations.
tips: Tailing: keep the target in sight without closing in too far, the standard follow discipline.
The mission has two threads - Lucia's tail and Jason's meeting with Karim.

missions.name: Credit Check
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia visit Raul's base and meet the people involved in his operation - the crew for the coming heist. The mission provides the Dye Pack Jammer for the heist preparations.
tips: The crew you meet here are the Cartel Heist team; the following missions are their preparations.
The Dye Pack Jammer is a heist-prep item - it is earned here, not bought.
missions.reward_notes: Unlock reported by GTAside; no cash reward reliably reported.

missions.name: Steal the Zorrusso for Randy
missions.overview: The pair steal a high-end Zorrusso for Randy, cloning its keys - PowerPyx's on-screen mission name is 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS'. Completing it opens Randy's wish list of further cars to steal.
tips: This is a high-end car theft - expect security around the Zorrusso.
Finishing it opens Randy's wish list, a repeatable source of car-theft work.
missions.reward: Unlock: Randy's wish list (car theft requests)
missions.reward_notes: Unlock reported by GTAside; no cash reward reliably reported.

missions.name: Sinfrontera National Bank
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia scope out the Sinfrontera National Bank, the target of the coming robbery. The casing begins the formal Cartel Heist preparations.
tips: This is a scouting mission - the bank layout you see here is the heist location in The Cartel Heist.
It is the first of the dedicated prep missions: Sinfrontera National Bank, Security Expert, Safe Word and Hidden Charges all feed the finale.

missions.name: Security Expert
missions.overview: The pair meet Nicole, a security expert, and complete the security-related preparations for the robbery. Her expertise covers the security side of the Cartel Heist plan.
tips: Nicole is the heist's security contact - this prep pairs with Safe Word's safe-cracking.
Part of the Cartel Heist prep chain; do it before Hidden Charges and the finale.

missions.name: Ride or Die
missions.overview: Jason helps Dre'Quan with his latest assignment. It continues Dre'Quan's storyline alongside the heist preparations.
tips: Jason-led mission - start it while controlling Jason.
It can be done between heist prep missions while waiting for crew contacts to call.

missions.name: Company Property
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia complete a job involving a weapons shipment, working with Brian. The shipment job runs alongside Raul's heist preparations.
tips: A weapons-shipment job - expect armed opposition around the cargo.
Brian returns as a contact for this one; it is separate from Raul's prep chain.

missions.name: The Missing Link
missions.overview: Lucia follows an assignment involving a cockfight and the contacts connected to it. It continues her solo work during the heist build-up.
tips: Lucia-led mission - start it while controlling Lucia.
Only brief objectives are published for this mission; follow the in-game trail markers.

missions.name: Safe Word
missions.overview: Lucia steals a practice safe and learns the safe-cracking technique from it. The skill is direct preparation for the Cartel Heist.
tips: The technique learned here is used in The Cartel Heist - do not skip this prep.
Lucia-led mission in the heist prep chain.
missions.reward_notes: Unlock reported by KeenGamer ('learn the required technique'); no cash reward reliably reported.

missions.name: Cooties
missions.overview: Lucia helps with a music video shoot, tied to the Real Dimez music circle. It is a lighter assignment in the run-up to the heist.
tips: A shoot-day mission rather than a combat job.
Lucia-led; it sits between Safe Word and Bricked Up in every list checked.

missions.name: Bricked Up
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia complete a job working for Boobie. It is Boobie's main assignment for the pair after his introduction in Boobie Time.
tips: This is Boobie's follow-up to Boobie Time - both protagonists take part.
It is the last contact job before the final heist preparations in Hidden Charges.

missions.name: Hidden Charges
missions.overview: The crew meets and prepares the explosives needed for the Cartel Heist. It is the final preparation mission before the robbery itself.
tips: Last prep mission - after this, only The Cartel Heist remains in the chapter.
Make a manual save after finishing it, before starting the heist.

missions.name: The Cartel Heist
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia rob the Sinfrontera National Bank with Raul's crew, using the preparations from the preceding missions - the Dye Pack Jammer, Nicole's security intel, the safe-cracking technique and the explosives. Completing the heist finishes Chapter 3.
tips: Complete every preparation mission first (Sinfrontera National Bank, Security Expert, Safe Word, Hidden Charges) - KeenGamer stresses the preps introduce the equipment and people the robbery needs.
Make a manual save before starting - it is the chapter finale and there is no mission replay.
missions.reward_notes: Heist payout NOT reliably reported by the sources checked - no amount is recorded here rather than guessing.
missions.missable_warning: Optional 'Race Against Yago' (Yago questline, Chapter 3) is time-sensitive: complete it as soon as its hourglass marker appears or it can be missed (PowerPyx / KeenGamer). It is not required for trophies or 100%.

missions.name: Ocean Beach
missions.overview: Chapter 4 opens with Jason and Lucia establishing their new setup in Ocean Beach, Vice City. It follows the Cartel Heist and re-bases the pair for the chapter's jobs.
tips: Make a manual save at the chapter start - there is no mission replay.
The chapter's through-line is preparation for the VCIA Takedown airport heist (KeenGamer).

missions.name: Another Life
missions.overview: A personal, Lucia-focused mission following her story and the chapter's opening events, touching on her past. It opens her Chapter 4 thread before the crew work begins.
tips: Lucia-led mission - start it while controlling Lucia.
Overview is based on brief guide summaries (KeenGamer / GTAside: 'Lucia, past').

missions.name: Company Cars
missions.overview: The pair meet a concierge and obtain the new cars needed for the next jobs. It is an early setup mission for the chapter's heist preparations.
tips: Playable character is not consistently stated in the sources checked, so it is left blank rather than guessed.
The vehicles obtained here feed the chapter's following jobs.

missions.name: Lawyer Up
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia meet lawyer Abe Gonzalez and follow the legal-related objectives. Abe becomes a recurring contact - later story tasks include paying Abe's fee.
tips: Abe recurs in Chapters 4-5 story tasks (Pay Abe's Fee), so this introduction matters later.
A meeting/objectives mission rather than a combat job.

missions.name: Party Hard
missions.overview: The pair work personal security during a celebrity event. The protection job is part of their early Chapter 4 work for Vice City contacts.
tips: Personal-security work: stay close to the client during the event.
Playable character is not consistently stated in the sources checked.

missions.name: Heavy Lifting
missions.overview: A delivery assignment involving Jason and Lucia; GTAside's brief adds bringing Raul a hard drive. It continues the chapter's delivery and preparation work.
tips: KeenGamer describes it as a delivery involving both protagonists.
Overview beyond the delivery/hard-drive brief is not published in the sources checked.

missions.name: Photo/Shoot
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia join Dre'Quan and complete a promotional photoshoot. It continues Dre'Quan's music-business storyline in Vice City.
tips: A promo/photoshoot assignment with Dre'Quan (PlayerManual map objectives agree).
Playable character is not consistently stated in the sources checked.

missions.name: Making Gainz
missions.overview: Lucia begins a fitness-related assignment connected to Raul's plan, getting to know someone new in the process. PlayerManual's map objectives include a workout element.
tips: Lucia-led mission - start it while controlling Lucia.
It connects to Raul's wider plan for the chapter.

missions.name: Watch It
missions.overview: The pair meet Dre'Quan and follow a mission involving a nightclub owner. The meeting continues Dre'Quan's nightclub storyline.
tips: A meeting mission with Dre'Quan - expect introductions rather than a full combat job.
Playable character is not consistently stated in the sources checked.

missions.name: Cash Injections
missions.overview: Lucia continues an assignment involving Nate and the contacts needed for the heist, helping an associate along the way. KeenGamer frames it as Lucia's heist-contact work.
tips: Lucia-led mission - start it while controlling Lucia.
Nate recurs in Chapter 4 story tasks (Call Nate / Nate Will Be in Touch).

missions.name: Amateur Hour
missions.overview: Lucia and Cisco confront the director involved in their assignment. PlayerManual's map objectives also list a workout element for this mission.
tips: Lucia-led mission built around the confrontation with the director.
Overview is based on brief guide summaries rather than a full walkthrough.

missions.name: Dirty Work
missions.overview: The pair complete a job involving Raina and continue gathering contacts. KeenGamer places it within the VCIA Takedown airport-heist preparations.
tips: Part of the airport-heist prep chain - it feeds into Too Much Baggage's airport scouting.
Playable character is not consistently stated in the sources checked.

missions.name: Too Much Baggage
missions.overview: Jason works a baggage-handling assignment at the airport to scout it. The scouting is direct preparation for the VCIA Takedown airport heist.
tips: Jason-led mission - start it while controlling Jason.
Pay attention to the airport layout; you return here for VCIA Takedown.

missions.name: Adventures in Babysitting
missions.overview: Jason works security for Andres at a nightclub. It is a Jason-led protection assignment in the heist build-up.
tips: Nightclub security work - stay with Andres during the shift.
Jason-led mission (vi.ki / GTAside agree).

missions.name: Fresh Evidence
missions.overview: Jason goes after blackmail material with Dre'Quan, stealing the compromising evidence Dre'Quan needs for his plans. It is a theft-focused mission in the prep chain.
tips: Jason-led mission with Dre'Quan (vi.ki / GTAside agree).
The blackmail material is the objective - prioritize reaching it over optional fights.

missions.name: Power Play
missions.overview: The pair gather intelligence while helping Kordell's crew, collecting information for the VCIA Takedown. It sets up Team Building, where Lucia deals with Kordell's crew directly.
tips: Sources DISAGREE on the playable character: PC Gamer names Jason, PowerPyx marks it Lucia only (per vi.ki) - so it is left blank here rather than guessed.
The intel gathered here feeds the airport heist preparations.

missions.name: Child's Play
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia help rescue Rafa from his kidnappers. Trophy-list summaries associate the rescue with the 'Family Matters' trophy.
tips: A rescue mission - push to Rafa rather than clearing every optional enemy.
Rafa recurs in Chapter 4 story tasks after this mission.

missions.name: Headliners
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia help with the Real Dimez launch party at the VYB club, where the duo perform. Trophy-list summaries associate the event with the 'DWNFALL' trophy.
tips: An event/party mission rather than a combat job.
Both protagonists take part (vi.ki / GTAside agree).

missions.name: Close Surveillance
missions.overview: Jason uses a spy drone to observe designated targets - bodybuilders, per GTAside and vi.ki. The surveillance feeds the heist preparations.
tips: Jason-led drone mission - keep the drone on the marked targets.
A stealth/observation mission; combat is not the focus.

missions.name: Delivery Method
missions.overview: Jason completes an undercover assignment as part of the VCIA Takedown preparations. It is one of the final setup missions before the airport heist.
tips: Jason-led undercover work - follow the assignment's cover instructions.
It sits between Close Surveillance and Team Building in every list checked.

missions.name: Team Building
missions.overview: Lucia has to prove herself while working with Kordell's crew. Completing it firms up the crew for the airport operation.
tips: Lucia-led mission - start it while controlling Lucia.
It follows Power Play's introduction of Kordell's crew.

missions.name: Fully Catered
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia steal the catering vehicle required for the airport operation. It is the last major preparation before VCIA Takedown.
tips: Deliver the catering vehicle intact - it is needed for the heist's cover.
After this, only VCIA Takedown and the chapter's closing missions remain.

missions.name: VCIA Takedown
missions.overview: The airport heist: Jason and Lucia carry out the VCIA Takedown using the crew and equipment assembled across the chapter's preparation missions. Trophy-list summaries associate it with the 'Hi-Jacked' trophy.
tips: Do not rush in - KeenGamer advises completing the available preparation missions first, and watching for calls from Raul's contacts and Dre'Quan if a marker has not appeared.
Make a manual save before starting - it is the chapter's heist finale and there is no mission replay.
missions.reward_notes: Heist payout NOT reliably reported by the sources checked - no amount is recorded here rather than guessing.

missions.name: Sunset
missions.overview: After the heist, Jason and Lucia look for answers about the aftermath, stopping by a front desk as they investigate. It is a quieter, story-focused mission before the chapter finale.
tips: Both protagonists take part (vi.ki / GTAside agree).
Overview is based on brief guide summaries ('look for answers / stop by front desk').

missions.name: Starting From Zero
missions.overview: The final mission of Chapter 4: hunted and broke, the pair look for a hard drive (per GTAScoop's brief). Several spoiler-averse lists redact this mission's name entirely.
tips: Name note: Dexerto and PC Gamer redact this mission as '[Spoiler]'; Space4Games, GameRant and VGC name it Starting From Zero - the name adopted here.
Playable character is not stated by the spoiler-averse lists, so it is left blank rather than guessed.
Make a manual save before the finale - it leads directly into Chapter 5.

missions.name: Bird in the Hand
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia steal a vehicle needed for their next operation; FinalBoss's walkthrough adds that they scout the Coast Guard HQ. It opens the final chapter.
tips: Both protagonists take part (vi.ki / GTAside agree).
Make a manual save at the chapter start - the finale chain has no mission replay.

missions.name: Taking Liberties
missions.overview: The couple prepare their next plan; FinalBoss's walkthrough adds a meeting with Giorgio to set up a shipment job. It begins the finale's chain of operations.
tips: Playable character is not stated by the spoiler-averse lists, so it is left blank rather than guessed.
Overview is based on brief guide summaries (KeenGamer / FinalBoss) rather than a full walkthrough.

missions.name: VC Baby
missions.overview: Mattia asks for help; FinalBoss's walkthrough has the pair talk to Mattia and help Kat. The request pulls them into the finale's chain of jobs.
tips: Giver is Mattia (vi.ki / FinalBoss agree he asks for help).
Order note: PowerPyx-derived lists swap this mission and Doggie Bag (3rd/4th); the adopted order follows the majority (KeenGamer, Space4Games, GameRant, Dexerto).

missions.name: Doggie Bag
missions.overview: The pair follow the markers to locate the required contraband; FinalBoss's walkthrough adds meeting Vinny and getting Rocco out. It feeds into the shipment recovery of Operation Savage Glory.
tips: Rocco, met here, is used in Operation Savage Glory per FinalBoss.
Playable character is not stated by the spoiler-averse lists.

missions.name: Operation Savage Glory
missions.overview: The operation to recover the shipment, using Rocco per FinalBoss's walkthrough. It is the last big job before the endgame assignments.
tips: This is the shipment-recovery operation set up by Taking Liberties and Doggie Bag.
Make a manual save before starting the endgame sequence.

missions.name: Protective Custody
missions.overview: Jason and Lucia work together through the final assignments before the ending; FinalBoss's walkthrough adds meeting Abe and a break-out to reach a warehouse. It is the penultimate mission of the game.
tips: Both protagonists take part (vi.ki / GTAside agree).
Keep a separate manual save before this mission if you want a return point before the finale (KeenGamer).

missions.name: The End of the Road
missions.overview: The final story mission: completing it finishes Jason and Lucia's campaign. FinalBoss's brief has the pair use a penthouse computer and reach Flemming Key.
tips: Keep a separate manual save before the finale if you want to preserve an earlier point in the story (KeenGamer).
After the story, free roam continues - collectibles, robberies, challenges and Strangers & Freaks remain available toward 100% (KeenGamer).
missions.reward: Story completion unlocks cheat codes (61 cheats, per vi.ki / PC Gamer)

loot.name: Palmer Fishing Warehouse (La Polilla Negra Illegal Operation)
loot.area: Bobcat Key, southeast tip of the Bobcat Keys sandbar
loot.island_region: Watson Bay / Grassrivers, Leonida Keys side

loot.name: La Polilla Negra KZ-59
loot.detail: Golden-yellow filigree frame, dark stock. Found upstairs in the warehouse. This is Jeff's 'legendary golden AK' — confirmed real.

loot.name: GLR40 grenade launcher
loot.detail: Standard GLR40 pickup on the ground-floor desk/workbench. NOT the legendary 'Deever Tech GLR40' variant — that one is in the Sunrise Motel garage in Tequesta.

loot.name: Fairview FF-SR
loot.detail: Also at Palmer per GTA6Heists' free-weapon spot list (KZ-59 + FF-SR + GLR40 all at this one site).

loot.name: Crowex Octane 'Elite' Watch
loot.detail: One of the operation's Key Valuables.

loot.name: Upstairs safe
loot.detail: Code 1886, found on a note on the ground-floor computer (or blow it with a Sticky Bomb).

loot.name: Cocaine / drug stock
loot.detail: Sell to a fence; part of the repeatable haul.

loot.cash_estimate: Safe held $3,020 in one documented run; map-card take $3,400-$5,400 (GTA6Heists data via gtamap.io). VARIANCE: social/TikTok guides claiming '~$10,000 cash' at Palmer are uncorroborated — the $10,200-$11,200 figure actually belongs to the Watson Bay Safehouse operation nearby (see watson-bay-safehouse). Jeff's '~$10k' estimate appears to conflate the two sites.

guards.description: Listed as a high-security Illegal Operation in gtamap.io's mission listings; Respec calls it 'smaller-scale' than the biggest compounds but it is a guarded La Polilla Negra site — expect multiple armed guards.

loot.directions: 1) Open the map and find Watson Bay on the west side of Grassrivers. 2) Look just west of town for the Bobcat Keys — a tiny chain of islands/sandbar. 3) Head to the southeast / very southern tip of Bobcat Key. 4) The warehouse is the La Polilla Negra operation there: clear the guards, take the GLR40 off the ground-floor desk, read the safe code (1886) on the ground-floor computer, then go upstairs for the golden KZ-59, the FF-SR and the safe.
loot.map_description: In map view the site sits on the small Bobcat Key island chain west of the Watson Bay label, at the sandbar's southeast tip, across the water from Grassrivers. Filter: Map > Robberies (money bag icon) > Illegal Operations; an unvisited site shows as 'Robbery Opportunity'.
loot.chapter_available: Chapter 2 (grouped with the Chapter 2 operations by TheGamesWiki)

loot.name: Watson Bay Safehouse (La Polilla Negra Illegal Operation)
loot.area: Eastern edge of Watson Bay, just outside town, west of Hamlet

loot.name: La Polilla Negra VF-G1
loot.detail: Black frame with gold barrel and magazine, filigree work and a gold death's-head moth emblem. Found upstairs. This is the actual '$10k site' weapon near Watson Bay — not the golden AK.

loot.name: Safe
loot.detail: Code 1819, from the computer past the kitchen. ~$3,336 taken from the safe in a documented guide run.

loot.name: B&G Ark Royal Quantum Watch
loot.detail: Listed as a Key Valuable by GTA6Heists map data.

loot.name: Canis Black Moth Kamacho
loot.detail: Listed as this operation's Key Valuable vehicle by GTA6Heists/gtamap.io. CONFLICT: Respec instead attributes a 'Black Moth Camacho' to Palmer Fishing Warehouse — see loot-notes.md.

loot.name: Sticky bombs + drug stock
loot.detail: Sticky bombs found on site; drugs sellable to a fence.

loot.cash_estimate: Map-card take $10,200-$11,200 (GTA6Heists data via gtamap.io) — this is the ~$10k figure from Jeff's example, attached to THIS operation rather than Palmer. Safe alone ~$3,336 in a documented run.

guards.description: Respec: 'a lot of La Polilla Negra lieutenants' on site — heavier resistance than a typical safehouse.

loot.directions: 1) Go to Watson Bay in western Grassrivers. 2) Head to the eastern edge of town, just outside it on the road toward Hamlet. 3) The safehouse is the guarded house there. 4) Inside, check the computer past the kitchen for safe code 1819, open the safe, and go upstairs for the gold-barreled VF-G1.
loot.map_description: Sits right at the east edge of the Watson Bay label in map view, between Watson Bay and Hamlet, on the western side of Grassrivers near the Leonida Bay coast.
loot.chapter_available: Chapter 2 (grouped with the Chapter 2 operations by TheGamesWiki)

loot.name: Vespucci Mansion (Illegal Operation)
loot.area: West side of Vespucci Island, near the main road
loot.island_region: Vespucci Island, Rialto Islands (between Vice City and Vice Beach)

loot.name: Kingpin Heathen
loot.detail: Checkered gray finish, gold barrel and magazine, 20 rounds. Hangs on the armory wall inside the mansion — end of the hall, turn right, on the same floor you enter from the roof.

loot.name: Two safes
loot.detail: Both inside the mansion; open both as part of the clear.

loot.name: Progen Royal Ruby Emerus
loot.detail: Free supercar parked outside by the spiral stairs on the way down. No key or tracker. Worth ~$30k sold in Top condition; registration costs about the same (registration itself unlocks in Chapter 2).

loot.cash_estimate: Two safes ≈ $9,000 combined cash (GameRant's Vespucci Mansion guide). VARIANCE: some secondary guides claim ~$30,000 combined from the safes — that figure was not confirmed in the guides cross-checked here; use ~$9k as the sourced number.

guards.description: Guarded mansion: guards on the roof and inside. GameRant's route: jump the front fence, take the spiral stairs to the roof, sneak or knock out the roof guards, then enter and stay on that floor to the armory.

loot.directions: 1) Cross to Vespucci Island — the oblong central island of the Rialto chain, Neptune Cir. 2) The mansion is on the west side near the main road. 3) Jump the front fence, climb the spiral stairs to the roof, deal with the roof guards quietly. 4) Enter, stay on the same floor, walk to the end of the hall and turn right into the armory. 5) Open both safes and take the Kingpin Heathen off the wall. 6) On the way back down the spiral stairs, take the Royal Ruby Emerus parked outside.
loot.map_description: Vespucci Island is the middle island of the Rialto trio at the top of the island group between Vice City and Vice Beach; Casanova Island is east/northeast of it, Catalan Island southwest, Salton Memorial Island southeast.
loot.chapter_available: Free roam (not chapter-locked; most Illegal Operations aren't)

loot.name: Casanova Island Mansion Garage — Gold Pegassi Torus
loot.area: House at the bottom-center / middle of Casanova Island, on the southern road
loot.island_region: Casanova Island, Rialto Islands (east/northeast of Vespucci Island)

loot.name: Gold Pegassi Charred Torus
loot.detail: Solid-gold Pegassi SUV (the game's Lamborghini Urus stand-in) parked in the estate garage. Front plate reads CASHTLKS (games.gg). NAME VARIANCE: Detonated lists it as 'Charred Torus'; Sportskeeda and social guides call the same car 'Lustrous Toros'. There is NO weapon at this site — the mansion's loot is this car.

loot.name: Key cloner required
loot.detail: The car is locked/alarmed with a tracker — you need the key cloner (story-unlocked later; social guides say Chapter 3's 'Clonin' Keys' mission) to actually take and keep it. Registration ~$29,900, sell value ~$6,250 per one video guide — treat those two figures as single-source.

loot.cash_estimate: No cash loot documented at this site; value is the vehicle itself.

guards.description: No guard crew documented in the guides checked — it's a private estate garage, not an Illegal Operation. Expect the car's alarm/tracker, not a firefight.

loot.directions: 1) Open the map and find the Rialto Islands — the chain of small islands in the bay between the Vice City mainland and Vice Beach. Vespucci Island is the middle of the three islands the Rialto Causeway (Rialto Cswy) runs across, between Catalan Island and Casanova Island. 2) Cross east from Vespucci Island onto Casanova Island, the island immediately east of it. 3) Drive to the big house in the middle of the island — Detonated describes it as the house at the bottom-center of Casanova, on the southern road. 4) Enter the garage at the estate. 5) The golden Pegassi Charred Torus (a gold SUV) is parked inside — check the front plate reads CASHTLKS to confirm you have the right car. 6) Before taking it, scan it with the Waink phone app: the scan lists the model, how you get in, which tracker it carries, its value and its registration cost. If it needs the Key Cloner, that tool only unlocks later in the story (Chapter 3), and a car with no tracker can be registered at Moses' shop in Port Gellhorn from Chapter 2.
loot.map_description: Casanova Island in map view is the island immediately east of Vespucci Island in the Rialto chain (community maps put it in grid E5), between the Vice City mainland and Vice Beach. Vespucci is the middle of the three causeway islands, so from the Rialto Islands label go one island east. Drop your waypoint on the big house at the center / bottom-center of Casanova — the estate with the garage, on the island's southern road — not on the island's name label itself.
loot.chapter_available: Garage can be visited in free roam, but taking the car needs the key cloner (story progression; reported as Chapter 3)

loot.name: Fishing Shacks (Kingfishers Illegal Operation #1)

loot.island_region: Northwest of Key Lento, toward Leonida Bay; west of Gullet Marsh / Cottonmouth

loot.name: Cash + cocaine
loot.detail: Standard Kingfishers haul; cocaine sells to a fence.

loot.map_description: Wetman Bay sits on the far western edge of the Grassrivers region, northwest of Key Lento, west of Gullet Marsh and Cottonmouth Lake, facing Leonida Bay.

loot.name: Sunrise RV Park (Kingfishers Illegal Operation #2)
loot.area: Cottonmouth Bay, just north of Cottonmouth Lake, east of Wetman Bay
loot.island_region: Northwest of Key Lento, Mariana County

loot.name: Kingfishers Akulus

loot.name: Dock safe
loot.detail: Safe code 6769 (games.gg safe-code list; note is in the Kingfishers shack).

loot.name: Cash + cocaine
loot.detail: Larger Kingfishers haul.

loot.cash_estimate: Average cash $3,100-$3,700 (TheGamesWiki Kingfishers table). Respec notes the total value often reaches five figures once the drug stock is sold.

guards.description: High security per TheGamesWiki. Introduced during the story, but it cannot be cleared at that moment — come back in free roam.

loot.directions: 1) From Key Lento head north to Cottonmouth Lake. 2) The RV park is on Cottonmouth Bay just north of the lake, east of Wetman Bay. 3) Clear the Kingfishers crew, open the dock safe with 6769, and search the park for the Akulus revolver.
loot.map_description: North of the Cottonmouth Lake label, on the bay shore, between Wetman Bay (west) and Hamlet (northeast).
loot.chapter_available: Chapter 2 grouping (TheGamesWiki); site is story-introduced earlier

loot.name: Manatee Motel (Kingfishers Illegal Operation #3)
loot.area: Northeast of Cottonmouth Lake, on the road toward Hamlet, eastern edge of Gullet Marsh

loot.name: Kingfishers Laird 350
loot.detail: OutputLag places it in the 2nd room of the run-down 'tiger motel' south of Hamlet — same site. OutputLag flags it as 'possibly missable if the motel boards up' — uncorroborated by other guides; treat as a soft warning, not confirmed missable.

loot.name: Cash + cocaine
loot.detail: Smallest Kingfishers haul of the three.

loot.cash_estimate: Average cash $1,400-$1,600 (TheGamesWiki Kingfishers table), plus cocaine.

guards.description: Rated High by TheGamesWiki, but also called the easiest of the three Kingfishers operations — expect a tiger on site and one truck of backup rather than a large crew.

loot.directions: 1) From Sunrise RV Park, follow the road northeast toward Hamlet. 2) The motel sits on the eastern edge of Gullet Marsh, northeast of Cottonmouth Lake. 3) Clear the site (mind the tiger), then check the motel rooms — the Laird 350 is in the 2nd room per OutputLag.
loot.map_description: Northeast of the Cottonmouth Lake label, southwest of Hamlet, at the eastern edge of the Gullet Marsh area.

loot.name: Gutterball Moreland 850

loot.name: Office safe

loot.name: Luxury watch
loot.detail: Third Key Valuable of the operation.

loot.cash_estimate: Up to ~$25,000 in sellable goods claimed by Respec — single-source high figure, treat as a ceiling rather than a typical take.

guards.description: High security per TheGamesWiki — a large, crowded site with possible reinforcements.

loot.directions: 1) In Port Gellhorn, head to the south of town near Moses' chop shop. 2) Enter the bowling alley and clear it. 3) Take the Gutterball Moreland 850 off the pool table in the NE corner, grab the watch, and open the office safe by the pins with 0300 (or sticky bombs).
loot.map_description: Southern Port Gellhorn, Kelly County, south of the town center and close to the Moses' garage/chop shop area.
loot.chapter_available: Chapter 2 grouping (TheGamesWiki); a Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling' also targets it (bloxodes robbery database)

loot.name: Truth & Justice Caracara 4x4
loot.detail: Unique vehicle at the warehouse (Respec).

loot.name: Small drug stock
loot.detail: Respec notes a small amount of drugs/vehicles compared with other Kolt sites.
